statement: For the positive 3n+1 odd-return map S and every positive odd target a, put K_d=L_+^d 1_units using the complete residue operator. Actual depth-d positive odd unit ancestors have reciprocal mass at least K_d(a)/a. If a is nonperiodic and the nonnegative series sum_d K_d(a) is not summable, the ordinary natural-number reciprocal indicator series of its actual positive odd unit ancestors is not summable. The proof identifies the full operator with actual predecessors and counts disjoint generations. The coefficient-series divergence premise remains OPEN. Kernel-checked; independent review and advisory statement coverage remain pending. The separate existence argument for a nonperiodic unit in every full fate class is not included in this formal row.
